barter.skycraft.hint: Click: trade one    Shift-click: trade the stack    A/D: change category
barter.skycraft.status.not_dealt: This merchant doesn't deal in that kind of merchandise
barter.skycraft.status.stolen: Stolen: only a fence will buy this
dialogue.skycraft.economy.barter: What have you got for sale?
dialogue.skycraft.economy.bulk.done: That'll do nicely. %s of them, %s gold for the lot.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.bulk.no_gold: I'm afraid I can't afford any more right now. Come back in a few days.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.bulk.nothing: You don't have anything I'd want to buy.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.bulk.partial: I'll take %s of them for %s gold. That's all the coin I have right now.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.greeting.apoth: Potions, poisons, ingredients. I have whatever ails you.
Mind the shelves. Some of these are quite... volatile.
Feeling unwell? I have just the thing.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.greeting.arcan: The arcane arts are not for the faint of heart. What do you seek?
Books, scrolls and other curiosities. Browse carefully.
Knowledge is the greatest treasure. But it isn't free.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.greeting.black: Need some new arms or armor? You've come to the right place.
Take a look, but don't touch unless you're buying.
Steel for the road, or iron for the wall? I have both.
Fresh food, straight from the fields and the hunt.
Hungry? Everything here was harvested this week.
Got some fine meat today, and bread still warm.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.greeting.gener: Take a look, but don't touch unless you're buying.
Welcome! Everything you need for the road, all in one place.
Got something to sell? Or are you here to buy?
dialogue.skycraft.economy.greeting.khaji: Khajiit has wares, if you have coin.
Greetings, friend. Come, look. Khajiit sells only the finest goods.
Ri'saad's caravans travel far. What does the traveler need?
dialogue.skycraft.economy.invest: I'd like to invest in your shop. (%s gold)
dialogue.skycraft.economy.invest.done: You'd do that for me? I won't forget this. With more coin I can buy and stock more wares.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.invest.no_gold: An investment? Come back when you actually have the coin.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.train: Can you train me in %s? (%s gold)
dialogue.skycraft.economy.trainer.done.0: Good. Keep practicing and it'll become second nature.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.trainer.done.1: There. Not bad at all. Want to go again?
dialogue.skycraft.economy.trainer.done.2: You've got potential. Remember what I showed you.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.trainer.limit: You need to put what you've learned into practice. Come back when you've gained more experience.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.trainer.no_gol: Training isn't free, friend. Come back when you have the gold.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.trainer.too_sk: You already know more about %s than I could teach you. Seek out a master.
message.skycraft.economy.book_already_re: You have already read this book
message.skycraft.economy.book_mastered: You have nothing left to learn about %s
message.skycraft.economy.inventory_full: You don't have room for that
message.skycraft.economy.no_merchant_gol: The merchant doesn't have enough gold
message.skycraft.economy.not_dealt: I don't deal in that kind of merchandise.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.closed: The shop is closed. Come back between 8 in the morning and 8 in the evening.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.house.buy: I'd like to purchase a home in town. (%s gold)
dialogue.skycraft.economy.house.furnish: I'd like to decorate my home.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.house.no_gold: A home here costs %s gold. Come back when you have the coin.
dialogue.skycraft.economy.house.none_ava: There are no homes for sale in this hold right now.
message.skycraft.economy.house.bought: You are now the proud owner of %s!
dialogue.skycraft.economy.greeting.jewel: Rings, circlets, a fine necklace. Only the best stones here.
Mind the cases. Every piece is set by hand.
Looking for something that sparkles? Or something to sell?
message.skycraft.economy.contraband: Moon sugar? Skooma? Get that out of my shop before the guards see it.
tooltip.skycraft.economy.contraband: Contraband in Skyrim and Cyrodiil: only fences and Khajiit caravans buy it there
economy.skycraft.home.door_offer: %s is for sale for %s gold. Sneak and use the door again to buy the deed.
economy.skycraft.home.telvanni_refuse: "A Telvanni tower for an outlander who can't even hold a ward? Come back when the College of Winterhold calls you a wizard."
economy.skycraft.home.haunted_warning: The old servants won't set foot in Benirus Manor after dark. You hear the dead still walk its halls.
economy.skycraft.home.haunt_rises: The restless dead of Benirus Manor rise from the cold floor.
economy.skycraft.home.haunt_laid: The dead of the manor are at rest. The house is truly yours.
barter.skycraft.buyback.empty: You have sold nothing to this merchant lately
message.skycraft.economy.confirm_equippe: %s is equipped. Click it again to sell it.
message.skycraft.economy.bound: %s is bound to you and can't be sold.
message.skycraft.economy.quest_item: %s is a quest item and can't be sold.
message.skycraft.economy.buyback_gone: That is no longer here to buy back.
